title: What it models

T0.name: Illustration
T0.meaning: Drawn only. Nothing is computed for it.

T1.name: Teaching model
T1.meaning: A simple model that shows how the part behaves. Not exact.

T2.name: Calculated model
T2.meaning: Values come from the part's data sheet numbers.

T3.name: Runs your firmware
T3.meaning: The real chip program runs, instruction by instruction.

none.name: No level
none.meaning: No model level is set for this part.

engine.label: Engine
engine.value: Arduino C++ subset interpreter, digital pin model

notModelledHelp: Not modelled yet means the part is drawn and wired but nothing is computed for it.
empty: No parts in this project yet.
